concept.title: Why DITA matters for technical writers
concept.shortdesc: Technical writers face increasing pressure to:

conbody.p: Technical writers face increasing pressure to:

ul.li: Produce documentation faster without sacrificing quality
Maintain consistency across large documentation sets
Deliver content to multiple platforms and formats
Enable AI-driven content retrieval and automation

conbody.p: DITA addresses each of these challenges through its modular, semantic, and metadata-rich approach to content creation.
